facts.subject: count:items
facts.assertion: Motir holds exactly 41 imported work items in total.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue returns every item: the connector applies no status filter (whole-history scope, ADR §1).

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Every item's Motir parent is the fixture parentId, translated through the fixture-id to Jira key map the loader records.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue reads fields.parent.key into parentExternalId; the importer resolves it in a second pass.

facts.subject: F-41
facts.assertion: The orphan task arrives with no parent.
facts.reason: fields.parent.key is empty, so parentExternalId is null.

facts.subject: parent
facts.assertion: The hierarchy reaches depth 3 (epic > story > subtask) and no deeper than the fixture.
facts.reason: Every parent edge arrives through fields.parent.key.

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Every item's type token equals its Jira issue-type name: Epic, Story, Task, Bug or Sub-task; the resolver maps it to the fixture kind.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue passes fields.issuetype.name as SourceIssue.type.

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Every item's status token equals the vendor state name the loader set, which is the fixture statusName.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue reads only the state name (fields.status.name).

facts.subject: F-28
facts.assertion: The cancelled item arrives with status token 'Won't do'.
facts.reason: fields.status.name is read.

facts.subject: F-40
facts.assertion: The cancelled item arrives with status token 'Won't do'.

facts.subject: status_done
facts.assertion: The done items (F-8, F-14, F-21, F-22, F-35, F-37, F-39) arrive with status token 'Done'.
facts.reason: fields.status.name is read.

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Each item's resulting Motir status category equals the fixture statusCategory (status_todo, status_in_progress, status_done; status_cancelled lands in the done category).
facts.reason: The status CATEGORY is derived by the mapping resolver from the state name, not read by the connector (docs/decisions/issue-importer.md §2); this is the proof's assertion about Motir.

facts.subject: status_done
facts.assertion: Every done item arrives with a non-null closedAt later than its createdAt.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue reads fields.resolutiondate.

facts.subject: F-28
facts.assertion: The cancelled item arrives with a non-null closedAt.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue reads fields.resolutiondate; this holds only because the loader's 'Won't do' transition sets a resolution.

facts.subject: F-40
facts.assertion: The cancelled item arrives with a non-null closedAt.
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue reads fields.resolutiondate; this holds only because the loader's 'Won't do' transition sets a resolution.

facts.subject: closed_at
facts.assertion: Arriving closedAt values equal the fixture's closedAt values.
facts.reason: The vendor stamps fields.resolutiondate at the time of the loader's transition, not the fixture's date; the fact checked is that the value is non-null and ordered, not equal.

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Every item arrives with a non-null createdAt, and a parent's createdAt is earlier than its children's (the loader creates parents first).
facts.reason: jiraConnector.mapIssue reads fields.created.

facts.subject: created_at
facts.assertion: Arriving item createdAt values equal the fixture's createdAt values.
facts.reason: The vendor stamps fields.created at load time; the connector reads it, but it is not the fixture value.

facts.subject: comment

facts.subject: comment

facts.subject: priority
facts.assertion: Fixture priorities lowest, low, medium, high and highest arrive as Lowest, Low, Medium, High and Highest, and map to the same Motir priority.

facts.assertion: Items with priority null (F-3, F-20, F-33) arrive with token 'no priority (field absent, token null)' and become Motir priority medium.
facts.reason: The connector passes the token; the resolver maps an absent or unmatched priority to medium (ADR §2).
